usage.callShape: GET https://news.apitoll.cloud/v1/cointelegraph/news?limit=3 (optional query params: lang, limit 1-50, search, full_text, views). x402 USDC on Base.
usage.outputShape: body.articles[] — each article has .postTranslate.title, .post_url, .full_text, .postTranslate.leadText, .postTranslate.published, .views; top-level body.count, body.source, body.lang, body.query
quirks: Article title/leadText/published live under articles[].postTranslate, not at the article top level
All query params are optional; bare GET returns latest feed (default limit 10, lang en)
full_text bodies are truncated with a [+N chars] marker
usage.guide: Call GET https://news.apitoll.cloud/v1/cointelegraph/news with optional query params (limit 1-50, lang one of en/tr/de/es/fr/it/jp/kr/br/cn/ar/in/tw/ru, search for full-text query, full_text/views booleans). Pay $0.005 USDC per call via x402 on Base — no API key or sign-in. Read articles from body.articles[]; the headline is articles[i].postTranslate.title, the URL is articles[i].post_url, and the body text is articles[i].full_text. Set ?search=<term> to query specific topics instead of the latest feed.
